description: This file defines classes for configuring and running an Orleans server silo, including message handling, silo configuration, and orchestration logic.

classes.name: CommonParameters
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for the server such as service and cluster IDs, ports, URIs, and feature flags.

classes.name: ServerRunner`1
classes.description: A generic class responsible for orchestrating the lifecycle of an Orleans server silo, including configuration, startup, message handling, and shutdown.

methods.name: ServerRunner`1.<init>
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the silo configurator and generates a unique silo name.

methods.name: ServerRunner`1.Run
methods.description: Main method to run the server, handling message reception, silo startup/shutdown, and restart logic.

methods.name: ServerRunner`1.ConfigureOrleans
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder with options, clustering, endpoints, and optional activation repartitioning.
